title: Quotation — the selling cycle's entry document
description: A quotation to a customer, priced but not yet an order. Its lifecycle is data (workflows/quotation.yaml) and its state enum here is parity-locked to that workflow: closing the enum is what makes a state the platform cannot execute a schema violation rather than a runtime surprise, and the asset gate refuses a schema and a workflow that disagree.

state.description: The workflow state. Kept equal to workflows/quotation.yaml's state set by the asset gate, so the schema cannot accept a state the workflow cannot execute.

company.description: The internal company the quotation is issued from.

valid_till.description: The date the offer lapses. Absent means no declared expiry.

party.description: Link to the party the quotation is addressed to.

lines.description: At least one priced line — a quotation with no line item is not an offer.

total.description: The grand total including taxes. Optional so a caller may send lines and let the platform derive it.

harvest: the quotation field surface (valid_till, party, currency, company, taxes, totals)
the parent/child shape: a document header with a priced line table and a tax table
the docstatus lifecycle the upstream doctype drives (0 draft -> 1 submitted -> 2 cancelled)
x-erp-provenance.note: Field and lifecycle shapes from the upstream quotation doctype, re-expressed as our own schema and workflow data. No upstream file was read into this repository; no upstream code, schema or text is copied or vendored.
